meta.basis: Editorial lane plans based on champion kits, not measured matchup win rates. Pairings are conditional strategic suggestions.

Ashe.tips: Use slows to extend favorable trades and arrow to start fights. Keep an escape route before stepping forward.
Ashe.caution: No dash; your support and positioning determine how safely you can pressure.

synergies.name: Braum
synergies.note: Repeated attacks help convert his passive marks into a stun.

synergies.name: Milio
synergies.note: Protection and extra attack reach support sustained kiting.

Caitlyn.tips: Pressure last hits with range. Place traps under immobilized targets and protect your push with vision.
Caitlyn.caution: Winning range does not make an extended lane safe from jungle pressure.

synergies.name: Lux
synergies.note: A landed binding can set up a trap and follow-up damage.

synergies.name: Morgana
synergies.note: Binding gives time to place a trap; spell protection can help preserve spacing.

Jinx.tips: Use rockets when range or grouped targets justify the mana. Fight from safety until a takedown opens a reset.
Jinx.caution: Avoid committing before enemy engage tools are accounted for.

synergies.name: Lulu
synergies.note: Protection helps Jinx survive long enough to trigger a reset.

synergies.name: Thresh
synergies.note: Lantern offers a repositioning option for an immobile carry.

Miss Fortune.tips: Look for bounce pressure in lane and a protected ultimate angle after allied crowd control.
Miss Fortune.caution: Hold your ultimate until enemies that can interrupt or reach you are controlled.

synergies.name: Leona
synergies.note: Reliable lockdown can hold targets in Bullet Time.

synergies.name: Nautilus
synergies.note: His engage can create a window for your ultimate.

Ezreal.tips: Use skillshots to farm under pressure, but weave attacks when safe. Preserve your blink against engage.
Ezreal.caution: Minions block your main poke; a safe lane does not guarantee wave priority.

synergies.name: Karma
synergies.note: Poke and shielding can support short trades and repositioning.

Lucian.tips: Trade around spell-and-attack sequences when your partner can support the commitment.
Lucian.caution: A forward dash is a commitment; check enemy cooldowns and jungle position first.

synergies.name: Nami
synergies.note: Empowered attacks and follow-up control support short burst trades.

Xayah.tips: Place feathers across the enemy's approach, then threaten a root when they step into the line.
Xayah.caution: Feather positions matter more than an unconditional counter label.

synergies.name: Rakan
synergies.note: Engage and disengage help set up feather follow-up.

Kai'Sa.tips: Follow allied crowd control when you can safely reach the target. Plan purchases around your intended ability evolutions.
Kai'Sa.caution: Do not use your ultimate into a fight your team cannot follow.

synergies.name: Nautilus
synergies.note: Crowd control provides setup for passive stacks and follow-up.

Vayne.tips: Take short safe trades in lane, then use spacing to find repeated attacks in longer fights.
Vayne.caution: Limited wave control makes ranged pressure and large enemy waves difficult.

synergies.name: Lulu
synergies.note: Peel buys room for repeated attacks in extended fights.

Draven.tips: Pressure when axe catches are safe and your support can contest space. Reset with your lead before overextending.
Draven.caution: Enemies can punish predictable axe landing positions.

synergies.name: Leona
synergies.note: Lockdown creates an early all-in window for axe damage.

Jhin.tips: Time trades around your ammunition and use allied damage to set up a root.
Jhin.caution: Reload windows limit sustained damage; avoid treating burst trades as extended all-ins.

synergies.name: Zyra
synergies.note: Ranged damage can set up your root and follow-up control.

Sivir.tips: Use wave clear to manage resets, preserving spell shield for the enemy's most threatening spell.
Sivir.caution: Short attack reach makes spacing important even when you control the wave.

synergies.name: Karma
synergies.note: Wave pressure and movement tools help coordinate disengage or chase.
